record.question:
You are an officer in charge of road safety in an urban area. A well-known political leader’s vehicle is
       repeatedly violating traffic rules, including signal jumping and driving on the wrong side. Your subordinate
       asks whether to issue a challan or ignore it due to political pressure. What should you do?
options: Ignore the violation to maintain cordial political relations.
Issue the challan according to the law, documenting all evidence carefully.
Give a verbal warning instead of official action.
Refer the matter to your senior officer before taking action.
